name: Bastion
_: Region 1's boss (owner answer Q-B1): the S3 core boss rebuilt as style 2, the teaching boss - the core behind a cover group of guns (decision F). Placeholder art drawn by the agent (decision G); the owner retouches the PNGs. The drafts: band.png (the intact band, closed looks), cracked.png and broken.png (read inside module rectangles), open.png (the core's exposed art), extras.png (spark, bays, capped plate, nozzle phases, blasts). docs/level-authoring.md, 'The boss', is the format. Hit points are owner answer Q-B3's MEDIUM values (M8 tunes them); scores are packed BCD per module.

palette._: COLPF0 cold-white edge, COLPF1 worn steel, COLPF2 reactor amber, COLPF3 hostile burgundy armour; flashLuma is S4a-ii's band flash.

motion._: The band drifts one colour clock every framesPerColourClock frames across travelColourClocks and back (plan §5.2); the win shakes it by HSCROL jitter (Q-S5).

chain._: The win: blasts along every module, the surviving armour included (§5.13.2 item 10).

fire._: The least frames between two firings of any module (one countdown, §5.13.2 item 6). The shots are S4a-ii's.

capped._: An emitter slot the level's laser tier does not enable becomes armour with the capped plate (extras.png) and these hit points.

nozzles._: The engine nozzles at both ends (decision D): the cells that show the left and the right nozzle glyph; S4a-ii animates their three phases.
